links.outcome: AI translation fluency, adequacy, meaning and error severity by language versus professional translation
links.effect: Pooled AI fluency 2.98 vs 3.90 for professional translations (difference 0.92; P<.001). Spanish was noninferior in adequacy and error severity, but Chinese, Vietnamese and Somali were inferior on all metrics, worst for Somali.
links.quote: The Chinese, Vietnamese, and Somali AI translations were inferior to the professional translations across all metrics, with the greatest differences for Somali.

screen.reason: Evaluates neural machine translation (Azure AI) accuracy and safety against professional human translators for pediatric discharge instructions across 4 languages. Does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice, but evaluates AI model translation performance.
